title: List the players' api id who had the highest above average overall ratings
question: List the players' api id who had the highest above average overall ratings in 2010.

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT 
    pba.player_api_id
FROM 
    Player_Basic_Attributes pba
WHERE 
    SUBSTR(pba.date, 1, 4) = '2010'
    AND pba.overall_rating > (
        SELECT 
            AVG(overall_rating)
        FROM 
            Player_Basic_Attributes
        WHERE 
            SUBSTR(date, 1, 4) = '2010'
    )
ORDER BY 
    pba.overall_rating DESC
